register_executor: register an executor type with its launch and optional create_handle methods in the registry
test_is_registered: test whether a given executor type is registered in the execution logic registry
get_launch_method: get the launch method for a registered executor type to run job groups asynchronously
get_create_handle_method: get the create_handle method for a registered executor type to build execution handles from database data
build_executor_info: build an _ExecutorInfo instance with launch and optional create_handle for a specific executor type
